message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or agree on another target). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards and the other players’ remaining cards are counted as negative points. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 2–8; 9–10 can use two decks). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 25 each of red, green, blue, yellow (numbers 0–9, two of each except one 0 per color), plus 8 “Draw Two”, 8 “Skip”, 8 “Reverse”, 4 “Wild”, 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile. Flip the top card to start the discard pile; if it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players sit clockwise. The direction can reverse with a Reverse card. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches either the **color**, **number/symbol**, or is a **wild**. If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two** (+2 cards to next player)
• **Skip** (next player loses their turn)
• **Reverse** (changes direction; acts like Skip if only 2 players)
• **Wild** (player chooses new color)
• **Wild Draw Four** (player chooses new color; next player draws four unless they challenge) | | **Challenging Wild Draw Four** | If a player believes the previous player had a matching color card but played Wild Draw Four, they may challenge. If the challenger is correct, the original player draws 4 cards instead of the challenger. If incorrect, the challenger draws 6 cards. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and someone else notices before the next player plays, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | First player to discard all cards wins the round. Score points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Game End** | Continue playing rounds until a player reaches the agreed point total (commonly 500). | --- ### Quick Play Tips 1. **Keep track of colors** – If you’re holding many cards of a single color, try to keep them in reserve for later turns. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save Wild Draw Fours for when you’re about to win or when you need to block a strong opponent. 3. **Watch opponents’ patterns** – If someone keeps drawing, they might be low on cards or stuck on a particular color. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge Wild Draw Four if you’re sure the previous player could have matched the color. Wrong challenges cost you more cards. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
